payload.text: **Estate coordination by layer (hv, 27 Oct, decision 22):** L1 devbin, molt, utilz, gtools, then L2 intent, then L3 laksa and conflab, which do nothing until called. One heavy at a time on rhadamanth, and a kovacs leg counts as heavy. The desk runs on Intent's slots with molt-vc as controller, re-taken at each new session with `intent estate control take --node vc`. READY is `slots ask`, GO is `slots grant <id> --lane <every lane held>`, and START and END are `slots start` and `release`, with kovacs ones `--relayed`. molt-vc books its own short runs, and sends kovacs-sysadm one combined message per batch, since hv approves each one there.
